# NFSU.cc — Need for Speed Underground (2003) Static Recompilation in WebAssembly

> Play the original 2003 PC version of Need for Speed Underground free in a browser tab at https://nfsu.cc/ — no download, no install, no emulator.

NFSU.cc is a static recompilation of the original 2003 Windows executable (`Speed.exe`, 3.18 MB, md5 `b6b9232c55376b3c38c56aac1f8a121d`, 13,764 x86 functions lifted to C and compiled to WebAssembly) with a custom browser host layer replacing Win32, DirectX 9 (WebGPU with automatic WebGL 2 fallback and native BC1/2/3 S3TC textures), DirectInput (keyboard, gamepad, touch), and DirectSound (Web Audio). Includes **Original 2003** and **Remaster** modes plus the full original soundtrack.

- Full single-file technical compendium for LLMs: [https://nfsu.cc/llms-full.txt](https://nfsu.cc/llms-full.txt)
- Atom RSS feed (engineering updates): [https://nfsu.cc/feed.xml](https://nfsu.cc/feed.xml)
- Source code & architecture: [https://github.com/Caliko06/need-for-speed-underground-browser](https://github.com/Caliko06/need-for-speed-underground-browser)

## Play & Entry Points

- [Play Need for Speed Underground Online](https://nfsu.cc/): Main entry point (launcher on desktop, direct boot with touch controls on phones/tablets).
- [Launcher & Settings](https://nfsu.cc/launcher.html): Quality presets, Original 2003 vs Remaster, key rebinding, local IndexedDB save backup/restore.
